# Brex — Brex for startups

Brex cardholders get a catalogue of third-party partner perks, headlined on the startups page as "Over $350K in discounts and credits on AI and SaaS". The figure is stated as a floor, not a cap, so no maximum is recorded. A named subset is the "Day Zero Stack".

### Where it is available

confirming it is available where you are — check their terms before applying.

### Notes

amount_max is left null deliberately: the vendor publishes "Over $350K", which is a floor on aggregate partner value, not a credit ceiling, and rounding or reinterpreting it would misstate the offer. Brex publishes no eligibility criteria for the perks beyond being a Brex cardholder. Individual Day Zero Stack perks carry their own third-party conditions (e.g. AWS "$5,000 in AWS credits depending on Activate eligibility"; Slack "30% Off Slack Pro or Business+ plan for the first 12 months for companies with no more than 200 employees"), and Brex states "These partnerships are always subject to change." This is an aggregate partner-perks figure, not Brex credit. No eligibility criteria are published on the page. This is an aggregate partner-perks figure, not Brex credit.
